description: The Oppo F33 Pro features a premium design and a distinctive look. The handset features a 6.57-inch flat AMOLED display. The smartphone is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max processor and runs Android 16. Check out the first impressions to know more about the device.
title: Oppo F33 Pro 5G First Impressions

description: Astronomers discovered a rare Einstein Cross around galaxy J1453g, revealing a stellar structure similar to the Milky Way. The finding challenges current theories of how elliptical galaxies form and evolve.
title: New Einstein Cross Reveals Surprising Galaxy Evolution

description: A suspenseful reality show where one contestant hides a million dollars while others try to expose them.
title: Million Dollar Secrets Season 2 OTT Release: Date, Platform, Plot, Cast and What to Expect

description: Fake Profile Season 3 is a Colombian series that has now arrived on Netflix. The series features Carolina Miranda and Rodolfo Salas in the lead roles.
title: Fake Profile Season 3 Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Colombian Series Online

description: Directed by Peter Farrelly, Balls Up is an American Action-Comedy Film which has finally made its way to Amazon Prime Video. It is a blend of comedy, thrill, and action.
title: Balls Up Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This American Action-Comedy Film Online

description: Red Magic 11s Pro has been spotted on the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification database in Thailand, according to a report. The listing suggests that the handset could be launched in select global markets soon by the Nubia sub-brand. The rumoured gaming smartphone is said to ship with similar specifications and features to the Red Magic 11 Pro+, which was launched in China in October last year. Hence, the Red Magic 11s Pro is expected to be powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, coupled with up to 24GB of RAM and up to 1TB of internal storage.
title: Red Magic 11s Pro Global Launch Seems Imminent as Gaming Smartphone Surfaces on Certification Database

description: Xiaomi 17 Max launch seems imminent as they have reportedly been spotted on the  SRRC (State Radio Regulation of China) website in China. The listing doesn't offer many details about the upcoming smartphone, but it reveals its model number. Xiaomi 17 Max is tipped to feature a Leica-branded triple rear camera unit. It is expected to be announced in China in May.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Turns Up on China's SRRC Database, Could Launch Soon

description: Oppo Reno 16 Pro series’ key details have surfaced online, including its specifications, features, colour options, and RAM and storage configurations. The purported Oppo Reno 15 Pro successor is said to be launched in four colourways, including black, green, purple, and white. The lineup is tipped to go on sale in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 256GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage options. A tipster claims that the rumoured Pro series will be powered by either the octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ or the Dimensity 9500s chipset.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro Series Key Features, Colourways and Other Details Surface Online

description: Zerion revealed that North Korean-linked hackers used AI-enabled social engineering to carry out a cyberattack, resulting in a $100,000 loss. While user funds remained safe, the incident highlights evolving threats in the crypto ecosystem. Experts warn that increasingly sophisticated tactics are making attacks harder to detect.
title: Zerion Links Crypto Cyberattack to North Korean Hackers Using AI Tactics

description: Sony Xperia 1 VIII is said to be in the works, and it is likely to succeed the Xperia 1 VII, which was launched in May last year. Ahead of the formal launch, the phone has been listed on the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) website, revealing a few connectivity details. The listing shows that the new phone will have a 3.5mm headphone jack.It is expected to offer wireless charging.
title: Sony Xperia 1 VIII Could Feature a Headphone Jack and Support Wireless Charging, FCC Listing Suggests

description: Choosing the right printer for office use often comes down to factors like speed, reliability, and connectivity. In India, brands such as HP, Canon, and Brother offer a wide range of monochrome laser printers suited for different types of workloads. There are compact all-in-one options that handle printing, scanning, and copying, as well as more robust models designed for heavier usage. This list brings together some of the best business printers currently available, with options like the HP Laser MFP 323 series, Canon imageCLASS range, and Brother DCP lineup, starting from Rs. 17,399.
title: Best Business Printers in India for Office Printing Needs

description: First previewed in 2023, it is a watermarking technology that adds an invisible and imperceptible layer of watermark into the content, including text, images, videos, and audio. The Mountain View-based tech giant claims that SynthID cannot be removed, but a developer is now claiming that he was not only able to reverse engineer the watermarking tech, but also distort it to the level that it confuses systems detecting AI content.
title: Google’s SynthID AI Watermarking Tech Claimed to Be Reverse-Engineered

description: Samsung is speculated to be working on a new foldable smartphone form factor, with a recently surfaced patent hinting at a tri-fold design. The development comes as the company is expected to expand its foldable portfolio following the introduction of the Galaxy Z Tri-Fold in 2025. The patent suggests Samsung may be working on a more experimental form factor and offers an early look at what could be a tri-fold device with a significantly wider display.
title: Samsung Patent Hints at Triple-Folding Galaxy Z TriFold Wide With Broader Display

description: Qualcomm has been widely rumoured to adopt a dual-chip strategy for its next-generation flagship chipset lineup. The rumour mill suggests it could introduce a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset alongside a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC. According to a tipster, the standard variant will target a different segment of the premium smartphone market. The leak also sheds light on the specifications of the standard SoC and how it may differ from the Pro variant.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Specifications Leaked: Here's How It Differs From the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro

description: OnePlus has begun teasing the Buds Ace 3 alongside the upcoming Ace 6 Ultra in China, with a Weibo post hinting at a launch later this month. The earbuds are shown in black and white colour options with a familiar in-ear design and compact case. They are claimed to support up to 55dB ANC and up to 54 hours of battery life. OnePlus also highlights FPS-focused audio tuning. The Buds Ace 3 are expected to arrive as an upgrade over the Buds Ace 2.
title: OnePlus Buds Ace 3 Launch Teased, Might Debut With OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra This Month

description: Santa Monica Studio's God of War spinoff title with Faye as the protagonist will also reportedly feature Tyr. According to a report, the game could explore multiple mythologies, including Mayan, Chinese, and Japanese. The game has not been officially revealed by Sony and Santa Monica.
title: God of War Spinoff Game Will Reportedly Feature Tyr,  Explore Multiple Mythologies

description: Web3 hacks resulted in $482 million in losses in Q1 2026, according to a Hacken report. While losses declined year-on-year, phishing attacks and social engineering remained the biggest threats. The findings highlight ongoing security challenges as attackers continue to exploit vulnerabilities across crypto platforms.
title: Web3 Hacks Cost $482 Million in Q1 2026 as Hackers Lean on Phishing, Social Engineering

description: Xiaomi TV S Mini LED series 2026 has been launched in India. The new lineup is available in 55-inch, 65-inch, and 75-inch display options with 4K resolution. It runs on a quad-core A55 CPU coupled with a Mali-G52 GPU. For casting, the smart TV series has AirPlay 2, Google Cast, and Miracast. The price of Xiaomi TV S Mini LED smart TV series starts at Rs. 51,999 for the base model with a 55-inch screen.
title: Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series (2026) Launched in India With 4K Display, 34W Quad Speaker Unit

description: Motorola has confirmed that the Edge 70 Pro will launch in India on April 22, with availability via Flipkart. The phone will offer Pantone-inspired finishes and feature a 6.8-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with 144Hz refresh rate and 5,200 nits peak brightness. It will be powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset with up to 12GB RAM, run Android 16-based Hello UI, and include AI features. The handset will pack triple 50-megapixel cameras, a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging, and IP68/IP69 ratings.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro India Launch Date Announced; Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: Meta announced a new partnership with semiconductor giant Broadcom on Tuesday. The collaboration is focused on developing multiple generations of custom silicon for Meta’s artificial intelligence (AI) apps and services. Currently, the company powers its AI compute via the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator (MTIA) chips.
title: Meta Partners With Broadcom to Develop Next Generation of Its AI Chipsets

description: OnePlus Pad 3 Pro has reportedly been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number OPD2514. The rumoured flagship OnePlus tablet was listed on the website with Qualcomm’s flagship octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. Moreover, the OnePlus Pad model is expected to feature 12GB of RAM and run on Android 16, along with OxygenOS 16. This comes shortly after the tech firm began teasing the launch of a new OnePlus Pad series model in India. While the name of the device remains under wraps, it is expected to be marketed as either the OnePlus Pad 3 Pro or the OnePlus Pad 4.
title: OnePlus Pad 3 Pro Likely to Feature Same Snapdragon Chipset Seen on OnePlus 15, Geekbench Listing Shows

description: Samsung Galaxy S25 series smartphones have received price cuts in India, with revised prices now live across Flipkart and Amazon. The Galaxy S25 now starts at Rs. 56,999, while the Galaxy S25 FE is listed at Rs. 44,999. The Galaxy S25 Ultra price has dropped to Rs. 99,999. Samsung has not confirmed whether these are permanent reductions or limited-time offers. The price drop comes months after launch and follows the global debut of the Galaxy S26 series, which may have influenced the revised pricing.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, Galaxy S25 FE and Galaxy S25 Get Price Cuts in India

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the smartphone maker’s T lineup. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country on April 21 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart and the Vivo India online store. The phone will be available for purchase in Cosmic Black and Glacier Blue colour options. Moreover, it is offered in 8GB + 128GB, 8GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 256GB  RAM and storage configurations. The handset is powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, paired with a 9,020mAh battery.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G Launched in India With 9,020mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Google on Monday announced the global rollout of its upgraded Google app for desktop on Windows. It brings AI-powered Search features directly to users’ PCs. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the app integrates AI Mode in Search, which enables users to ask questions and receive contextual responses without opening a browser. The new Google app for Windows combines web search, local file discovery, and AI tools into a single interface.
title: Google App for Windows Rolls Out With AI Mode, System-Wide Search and Lens Features

description: Redmi A7 Pro 5G is now on sale in India, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Wednesday. The handset was launched in the country on April 13 as the first Pro model in the tech firm’s A series. Buyers can purchase the Redmi A7 Pro 5G via Amazon and the Xiaomi India online store. The smartphone is offered in 4GB + 64GB and 4GB + 128GB RAM and storage configurations. Moreover, it is available in three colour options, dubbed Black, Mist Blue, and Sunset Orange. The new Redmi phone is powered by a Unisoc T8300 chipset. The handset also boasts a 6,300mAh battery.
title: Redmi A7 Pro 5G With 6,300mAh Battery and 6.9-Inch Display Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Oppo F33 Pro 5G has been launched in India, along with the new Oppo F33 5G. The two new phones have been introduced as the latest additions to the tech firm’s mid-range F lineup. The Oppo F33 Pro 5G is slated to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Oppo India online store. The Pro model is offered in three colour options, dubbed Misty Forest, Passion Red, and Starry Blue. The handset will also be available for purchase in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The smartphone is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max chipset, which is built on a 6nm process.
title: Oppo F33 Pro 5G Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Oppo F33 5G was launched in India on Tuesday, alongside the Pro model. It arrives as the successor to the F31 5G, which was introduced in September 2025. The Oppo handset comes with a 6.57-inch Full HD+ AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. Under the hood, it is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 chipset, coupled with up to 8GB of RAM. The Oppo F33 5G gets an IP66 + IP68 + IP69-rated build for dust and water resistance.
title: Oppo F33 5G Launched in India With Dimensity 6360 Max Chip, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin is trading near $74,000 after pulling back from a recent high, as profit-booking is capping gains. Despite this, strong whale accumulation and improving sentiment continue to support the market. Analysts say macro factors and institutional flows remain key drivers, keeping Bitcoin in a consolidation range. A sustained move above resistance could signal further upside.
title: Bitcoin Price Consolidates Near $74,100 Following Pullback From Recent Rally

description: Microsoft has reportedly increased the price of the Surface lineup in the US. The Surface Pro 12-inch is currently available for $1,049, instead of $799 (roughly Rs. 67,000). The 13-inch Surface Pro 13 is listed for $1,449, marking a price increase from last year's $1,199 (roughly Rs. 1,11,000). The recent increases in memory and component costs are the reason for the price hike.
title: Microsoft Surface PC Prices Raised as Memory Costs Rise; Flagship Devices Hit the Hardest

description: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will launch in China soon. The exact launch date has not been revealed, but the company has posted multiple teasers showcasing the design of the phone. It is shown in an 'Ace Awakening' colourway with a reflective Ace logo in the centre. It is teased to debut as a gaming-focused offering with a 165Hz refresh rate display. The OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra is rumoured to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC and a 6.8-inch display with 1.5K resolution. The handset could include an 8,500mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Confirmed to Launch Soon; Design, Colourway Teased

description: DJI Osmo Pocket 4 has leaked ahead of its expected launch, with images shared by a tipster on X revealing the design and a large accessory bundle. The camera is tipped to feature a 1-inch sensor, 4K 240fps recording, D-Log support, and 107GB storage. It may also support Wi-Fi 6, USB 3.1, and offer up to 240 minutes of battery life. Pricing could start at EUR 499 (roughly Rs. 46,500). The leak also reveals a Pocket 4 Pro with a possible dual-lens setup and 3x optical zoom.
title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4 Design Renders Leaked Ahead of Launch With 1-Inch Sensor, 4K 240fps Support

description: Sony has announced an R-rated animated film adaptation of Bloodborne, FromSoftware's beloved action-RPG. Announced at CinemaCon this week, the Bloodborne movie will be produced by popular YouTube Jacksepticeye. Sony said the film will stay "very true" to the spirit of the game.
title: Bloodborne Animated Film Adaptation in the Works at Sony

description: Google on Monday announced the rollout of Personal Intelligence for Gemini in India. The feature expands the AI assistant’s capabilities with contextual responses and improved app integration. First introduced in the US earlier this year, Personal Intelligence allows Gemini to connect with select Google apps and utilise that data to provide more accurate and detailed responses to queries.
title: Gemini Personal Intelligence Rolls Out in India With App Integration, Contextual AI Responses

description: Google introduced the new Skills in Chrome functionality on Tuesday. The feature allows users to enter preset AI queries or commands, or ask Google’s AI chatbot to perform a particular task with a single click. Skills in Chrome works with Gemini AI to generate answers for a user’s queries. Users can create specific single-click commands and edit them directly in the Gemini in Chrome sidebar, appearing next to the text box. This eliminates the need for users to type their frequently-used queries or commands repeatedly, which might save time and effort.
title: Google Chrome Updated With AI-Powered 'Skills' Feature That Lets Users Execute AI Tasks With a Click

description: Amazon on Tuesday announced plans to acquire satellite communications company Globalstar. The move will allow Amazon to expand its low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite internet constellation under its Amazon Leo initiative. The e-commerce giant has also entered into a new agreement with Apple, which will result in continued support for satellite features on Apple devices like the iPhone and Apple Watch.
title: Amazon Announces Globalstar Acquisition; Partners With Apple for Satellite Features on iPhone, Apple Watch

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra is one of the best-suited Android flagships for camera enthusiasts who do not want to compromise on any front. It gets the best processor under the hood for ultimate performance, and the display doesn't disappoint. The battery is decent as well, making it one of the most complete camera flagships for those looking to buy one. Here's our full review.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Review: The New Gold Standard for Camera Purists
